notes.title: The bunnies are terrorizing gamescom!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

Our team has great news to share: 
We are exhibiting at gamescom Cologne! If you are planning to be there, you have one mission: 
Find the CobraTekku Games booth in hall 10.2 at the HOME of INDIES group booth.



This will be your reward: 

Chance to play the newest game version

Some CTG merchandise

A friendly chat with the lead devs behind the game



If you can't attend gamescom, don't worry: You can still play our newest demo or join our Discord: https://discord.gg/gDmTHH6T8W

 

We are looking forward to meeting you all!

notes.title: DEMO RELEASE - Experience the rebellion against the smartphone-addicted bunnies
notes.content:
Hello everyone,We achieved a milestone - our first demo! 
Thanks to your feedback from the playtest, we improved the beginning of the game and also included a mid-game level - The Hall of Fun!

So if you're up to the challenge, check it out or just enjoy the story and world of KIYO while playing the first hours of the game. 

You can also watch our impressive new trailer: [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kFEPWBAo8hg"][/dynamiclink]



So to summarize, the demo includes: 

1-3 hours of gameplay

The story intro, tutorial and beginning of the first mission

The challenging "Hall of Fun"

An explorable city, filled with all kinds of strange animals



If you'd like to help us improve the game, leaving a review on the demo page would be the best kind of support.

And if you haven't had enough, join our Discord and get the chance to playtest more of the game: 

https://discord.com/invite/gDmTHH6T8W



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44620699/6c5b19a5536042c797c0e0b0ff79a3211d4e59d7.gif"]

notes.content:

notes.title: Kiyo is part of Indie Game Fest!
notes.content:
Help Kiyo sabotage the greedy BunnyCorp!

We’re happy to announce that Kiyo is part of the Indie Game Fest event on Steam!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44620699/60fe4e43455b0f9133130a28de4f84c9b9a18a3b.gif

Explore Rabbithole City and tackle levels by sneaking, fighting and solving puzzles. Kiyo's gameplay is a combination of Thief, Splinter Cell and Oddworld, but in 2D pixel art.

Try it out for free, there's a public playtest available for the whole duration of the event.

If you like it, please wishlist it and tell your friends about it!

notes.title: Kiyo Playtest Update & End Date
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44620699/9e463099150cd6e087cd865d108f2f7eab87d3ae.gif

Hey guys!

We have 2 important news regarding the playtest!

Firstly, the build has just been updated. The game has had a couple of performance fixes and small adjustments to the gameplay. The biggest things can be broken into two categories:

 The first one is an option for making your own keybindings on a keyboard; we’ve received a lot of feedback on how players wanted to adapt the controls to their liking, so it was one of the biggest things that needed to be done; remapping the bindings on controllers is possible as well, but it would need to be done via the Steam Input system.
 Plenty of Linux-oriented stuff has been added to the respective build of the game; this means that the game should run on more distros, including the older ones.

Secondly, the playtest has a finishing date set and it will end on the 15th of March. We've got plenty of feedback, but we count on you to provide more. Especially considering that you like the game, which makes us extremely happy! After the playtest, we’ll take some time polishing the game up and preparing a proper demo release, which shouldn’t be far in the future. Wait for a proper announcement on this one!

Thanks for reading and for playing, have a good one!

notes.title: Kiyo is a part of Metroidvania Fusion!
notes.content:
Join The Resistance, fight evil bunnies!

We’re happy to announce that Kiyo is a part of the Metroidvania Fusion event on Steam! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44620699/6c5b19a5536042c797c0e0b0ff79a3211d4e59d7.gif

We got chosen to represent a cool niche in a genre that’s known for putting emphasis on many different areas of gaming, such as puzzle solving, combat or exploration. Kiyo’s all about stealth and it presents a more linear approach to the story. While our game isn’t a metroidvania in its purest form, we reckon it could be considered to be one. We really hope that you’ll like the game. Trying it out is free, as it’s undergoing a playtest.

If you wanna try something a bit different, give it a shot! If you like it, feel free to wishlist it and tell your friends about it!

notes.title: Kiyo's public playtest starts TODAY at 5 PM GMT!
notes.content:
Playtest starts today at 5 PM GMT!

The Resistance’s search has brought results. You, human, will take control over the body of Kiyo - an anthropomorphic lynx, ex-predator. Your ultimate goal: to destroy the evil BunnyCorp and restore the natural state of things. But for now, let’s start with small steps.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44620699/60fe4e43455b0f9133130a28de4f84c9b9a18a3b.gif

The test build will become the demo build over time. We need your help and feedback to make it as good as it gets. In the current version of the game, you’ll get to know how the story begins, will pass a tutorial section and will be able to take on a first mini-level. Aside from this, you’ll have plenty of venues to explore. The purpose of the playtest is to iron out all the bugs that are about to be found.

Join our Discord server to share your feedback and have a good time! 🙂

The playtest of Kiyo features:

 Tutorial level and first mini-level
 Most of the main gameplay mechanics are introduced: sneaking, archery, ninja rope, and cat vision. What are they? See for yourself!
 Two city neighbourhoods which you’ll be able to explore freely
 Working metro system
 Various indoor locations
 The beginning of the adventure is revealed
 Xbox controller recommended

Thank you all so much in advance for giving Kiyo a shot and seeing if you like the game. It’s a massive undertaking for our small team and we hope that you’ll realise Kiyo is something special. Cheers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44620699/6c5b19a5536042c797c0e0b0ff79a3211d4e59d7.gif

Known issues

 Certain antivirus software could block the game - that's a false positive
 PS5 controller not supported yet, but coming soon
 In case of input loss, switching to the menu and back to the game should solve it
 It requires a decent video card, and if it doesn't run smoothly there's a LowSpec option in the Video page of the menu.
 If playing on a laptop, please make sure the discrete GPU is selected by default for OpenGL programs (easy instructions for Nvidia)
 Linux version: joypads not supported yet, but coming soon

notes.title: Kiyo's first public playtest launching soon!
notes.content:
Help us improve the game and have fun at the same time!

The Owl needs a first cohort of brave humans to test his techno-magic interplanetary connection system. Beware: as part of this first wave you'll be little more than cannon fodder.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44620699/f3a5016af2bf6ebaf8c21ab3caf525a9872d8eae.png

What?
We are really excited to announce that we are almost ready to publish the first online playtest of Kiyo.
You will soon be able to play the beginning of Kiyo's adventure.
Experience an early version of Rabbithole City and help us polish the game with your feedback and bug reports.
We built our engine from scratch so it's really important for us to test it on as many different computers as possible. Exotic bugs might lurk in the corners of Kiyo's world.
Expect roughly 30 minutes of stealthy platform gameplay, but you'll be free to roam in the city and ride the metro as long as you want.

When?
The build will go live soon after the end of February's Steam Next Fest. 

How
Click on the "Request Access" button on the game's front page. Steam will send you an email when the Owl is ready.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2466790/Kiyo/

Stay tuned: we'll provide more info and dates in the next few days.
